methods.label: Use the sign rules for powers
methods.explanation: An even power of a negative number is positive: \((-2)^4=16\); an odd power of a negative number is negative: \((-1/2)^3=-1/8\).
methods.levelReason: Uses grade 7 power sign rules and previously learned fraction multiplication.
